title: Evidence
description: One provenance item supporting a license conclusion or finding. Conflicting evidence must be preserved, never silently flattened.

value.description: Observed value, e.g. an SPDX id or license file match.

source.description: Where the value came from, e.g. package.json, LICENSE, ClearlyDefined.

confidence.description: Technical detection confidence only — not legal certainty.
